name: Past Ouji
source:
Ouji's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]He made a contract with the brother of Futaba's past incarnation. He also fell in love with Asa, a human woman, who was tragically killed. This love carried over to his next incarnation (Ouji).[/spoiler]
Past Ouji was wounded by an arrow and died right in front of past Futaba, whilst begging her not to cry for him.
